title: operations.jobwork.challan.eway_requested
description: Operations asks finance to consider raising an e-way bill for one job-work delivery challan (Inventory plan Phase 6). Fire-and-forget, the same hook operations.dispatch.shipment.eway_requested set for carrier handovers: operations never calls finance's e-way machinery directly and never re-implements e-way validation. Emitted at issue when the consignment value is over operations' coarse threshold mirror (INR 50,000), and again whenever someone supplies transport facts for a challan (`:request-eway`). Money is integer minor units of `currency`.
$comment: Ahead of its consumer. services/finance generates e-way bills from an *invoice* (GenerateEwayIn.invoice_id); a delivery challan is not one, so a challan-keyed generation path in finance is a documented follow-up. This schema is the contract that path should be built against, not a description of a consumer that exists today.

supply_reason.description: The e-way 'supply type' reason: goods sent for job work (CGST Rule 55).

dispatched_at.description: When the challan was issued — the movement an e-way bill, once raised, licenses.
